result.summary: Found 3 issues on this food delivery app screen: one major content/display bug and two minor visual concerns.

issues.description: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card at the bottom displays '-0%', which is semantically meaningless and visually confusing. A zero-percent discount should not be displayed as a badge at all.
issues.suggestion: Remove the discount badge when the discount value is 0%, or only show the badge when there is an actual discount (e.g., > 0%). Fix the data pipeline that populates this value.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is partially clipped without a visible ellipsis on the card image, making it unclear the name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add a text ellipsis ('...') to clearly indicate the restaurant name is truncated, or increase the card width slightly to show more characters.

issues.description: The partially visible third card in the horizontal carousel has its image abruptly cut off with no fade or gradient to indicate scrollability, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge gradient fade overlay on the last visible card to visually hint that more content is available by scrolling horizontally.
